automations.name: Daily evidence sweep and gap detector
automations.cadence: daily, as the first job in _os/automation/cadence/daily.yaml
inputs: git status and git log across the local estate roots
Windows System event log Id 6008, or the macOS equivalent
automations.notes: Local evidence only: no network, no model, no credential, no canonical client write. Exit 2 is a successful run reporting bad news (missed day, stale artifact, undelivered brief, absent cadence run, lying ledger row, unscheduled driver, or a counter that fell from non-zero to zero). Exit 1 is the script breaking. Backfills MISSED rows for every day it was skipped, so a machine that was powered off still produces a written gap rather than silence. Self-check: --selftest.
